floor_history.headline: Recon: 3-insn gap fully characterised — 2 insns are the D_80101E70 reload gated on the pre-existing extern volatile the sandbox strips (17 vs 14 with --keep-cheat-asm); 1 insn is the a1->a3 parm copy

Structural axis measured dead: volatile carve-out census came back NEGATIVE (closed gate), 8-form ordering sweep found candidate.c is a strict local optimum in both regimes, and the missing a1->$a3 co

frontier.hypothesis: A decomp-permuter campaign seeded from candidate.c can find the RA/scheduling shape that four sessions of manual derivation have not. The permuter has still NEVER been run on this function.
frontier.mechanism: Random plus directed PERM_* mutation over statement order, temporary introduction, and expression spelling explores a structural space that the s2 hand-built 8-form sweep only sampled. s0 deprioritized the infra, s1 was recon modality, s2 was structural modality — the axis is entirely unexplored.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o from asm/funcs/replay_camera_Init.s + tools/decomp-permuter/prelude.inc (drop the `.set gp=64` line for r3000) so the function sits at offset 0 like base.o — per difficult-is-not-impossible.md §3 a whole-file target.o adds ~340k of constant score noise and makes the search useless. Seed from memory/grind/replay_camera_Init/candidate.c, launch via tools/permuter_campaign.py, wait IN-TURN with `permuter_campaign.py wait --dir <ws>`, and `harvest --stop` before writing the outcome.

frontier.hypothesis: The `addu $a3,$a1,$zero` is not the ordinary parameter home of a two-parameter leaf; the original compile's allocno set differs from ours in a way that has not yet been identified.
frontier.mechanism: s2 established a hard contradiction: in a two-parameter leaf whose only reference to $a1 is its own home copy, global.c's find_reg gives that pseudo hard reg 5 deterministically (preferences {5}, no constructible conflict on 5, lowest-free order, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER). Yet target puts it in $a3 (7), puts the D_80101E62 address in $t0 (8), and leaves hard regs 5 and 6 completely unused. Both the callee side (s1 H4: flow deletes dead parameter copies) and the caller side (s2: the caller never sets $a2/$a3 for the call) rule out a wider signature.
frontier.next_probe: m2c the target function and diff the reconstructed structure — in particular the number and lifetimes of distinct values — against our two-allocno shape, instead of assuming ours is the original's shape. Then re-run the cc1 -da dump on any shape m2c suggests and compare `;; N conflicts` / `;; N preferences` lines against target's implied 4/7/8 allocation directly.

frontier.hypothesis: The `s16 *s0 = &D_80101E62;` address cache — worth a measured -1 (14 -> 13) in the reload regime per s1 — is now proposable as a properly-annotated pointer-alias-fake-exception rather than the unannotated form s0's reviewer FAILed.
frontier.mechanism: pointer-alias-fake-exception is a SANCTIONED last-resort family (owner ruling 2026-07-01, SOTN precedent `tilemap = &g_Tilemap; // n.b.! unused, required for PSP`). Its prerequisites are documented lever-exhaustion, a named GCC-pass mechanism, and a `/* FAKE */` annotation — s0 supplied none of the three and was FAILed on that ground alone, with everything else passing. It reproduces target's exact address-materialisation shape (one lui;addiu reused for both the pre-branch lh and the post-branch sh, matching target's $t0).
frontier.next_probe: Only after the permuter axis has run (so the exhaustion record is genuinely complete): re-propose the alias with the full annotation — lever-exhaustion pointing at s1 H2/H3 and s2 H5/H6/H7, the named mechanism (single materialized address reused across the branch, defeating the second lui), and a `/* FAKE */` comment — then send it to a fresh cheat-reviewer. Note it is only worth -1 and only in a regime the honest sandbox does not score, so it cannot close the function by itself.
